review_harness.oracle_sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Reviewer S38 independent oracle v2 for tools/souji-verify.sh (round 2 spec).
# Not shipped; used to ground the reviewer's expected verdicts.
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="${SHOKUNIN_ROOT:-/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin}"
LANE_REPO="$ROOT/souji-shokunin"
LEDGER="$LANE_REPO/corpus/knowledge/obsidian-ledger.tsv"
STALE_DAYS=1
JSON=0
TARGETS=()

usage() { echo "usage: oracle.sh [--stale-days N] [--json] <path>..." >&2; exit 2; }

while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
  case "$1" in
    --stale-days) [ $# -ge 2 ] || usage; STALE_DAYS="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --json) JSON=1; shift ;;
    --selftest) echo "oracle: no selftest" >&2; exit 2 ;;
    --*) usage ;;
    *) TARGETS+=("$1"); shift ;;
  esac
done
[ "${#TARGETS[@]}" -gt 0 ] || usage

is_secret() {
  case "$(basename "$1")" in
    *.env|*credential*|*secret*|id_*|*.pem) return 0 ;;
    *) return 1 ;;
  esac
}

resolve_default_ref() {
  local repo="$1" ref single
  ref=$(git -C "$repo" symbolic-ref --quiet --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ -n "$ref" ]; then echo "${ref#origin/}"; return 0; fi
  single=$(git -C "$repo" for-each-ref --format='%(refname)' refs/remotes/origin/ 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^refs/remotes/origin/HEAD$' | sed 's@^refs/remotes/origin/@@' | sort -u)
  if [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$single" | grep -c .)" = "1" ]; then echo "$single"; return 0; fi
  if git -C "$repo" rev-parse --verify -q refs/heads/master >/dev/null; then echo master; return 0; fi
  return 1
}

# Intent of the spec's (literal, non-existent) `rg --basename`: zero live
# *content* references to the basename, under the D3 exclusions.
live_refs() {
  local name="$1" repo="$2"
  rg -l --no-ignore -F -e "$name" "$repo" \
     -g '!.git' -g '!**/souji-shokunin/census/**' -g '!**/souji-shokunin/tests/**' \
     -g '!**/.ufo-quarantine/**' 2>/dev/null | wc -l
}

ledger_match() {
  local path="$1" sha rowsp rs rv vp vs
  [ -f "$LEDGER" ] || return 1
  [ -f "$path" ] || return 1
  sha=$(sha256sum "$path" | cut -d' ' -f1)
  rowsp=$(awk -F'\t' -v p="$path" -v s="$sha" 'NR>1 && $1==p && $2==s {print NR}' "$LEDGER")
  [ -n "$rowsp" ] || return 1
  rs="${rowsp%%$'\n'*}"
  vp=$(awk -F'\t' -v n="$rs" 'NR==n{print $3}' "$LEDGER")
  vs=$(awk -F'\t' -v n="$rs" 'NR==n{print $4}' "$LEDGER")
  [ -f "$vp" ] || return 1
  [ "$(sha256sum "$vp" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$vs" ] || return 1
  return 0
}

wt_owner_of() { # path -> owner repo or empty; the main worktree is not a registration
  local t="$1" cand main
  for cand in "$ROOT/souji-shokunin" "$ROOT" "$ROOT"/*-shokunin; do
    [ -e "$cand/.git" ] || continue
    main=$(git -C "$cand" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || true)
    [ -n "$main" ] && [ "$main" = "$t" ] && continue
    if git -C "$cand" worktree list --porcelain 2>/dev/null | grep -Fxq "worktree $t"; then echo "$cand"; return 0; fi
  done
  return 1
}

OUT=()
for t in "${TARGETS[@]}"; do
  if is_secret "$t"; then OUT+=("$t|NOT-SAFE|secrets-refusal|basename matched secret pattern"); continue; fi

  owner=$(wt_owner_of "$t" || true)
  if [ -n "$owner" ]; then
    head=$(git -C "$owner" worktree list --porcelain | awk -v p="worktree $t" '$0==p{f=1} f&&/^HEAD /{print $2; exit}')
    br=$(git -C "$owner" worktree list --porcelain | awk -v p="worktree $t" '$0==p{f=1} f&&/^branch /{print $2; exit}')
    if [ -n "$br" ]; then
      unp=$(git -C "$owner" log --oneline "$br" --not --remotes 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
      if [ "$unp" != "0" ]; then OUT+=("$t|NOT-SAFE|unpushed-branch|branch=$br unpushed=$unp"); continue; fi
    fi
    if [ ! -e "$t" ]; then
      uniq=$(git -C "$owner" log --oneline "$head" --not --all 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
      if [ "$uniq" = "0" ]; then OUT+=("$t|SAFE|metadata-prune|unique=0 dir-absent"); else OUT+=("$t|NOT-SAFE|none|unique=$uniq"); fi
      continue
    fi
    d=$(git -C "$t" status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
    if [ "$d" != "0" ]; then OUT+=("$t|NOT-SAFE|dirty|dirty=$d"); continue; fi
    OUT+=("$t|NOT-SAFE|none|live worktree"); continue
  fi

  if [ -z "$t" ] || [ ! -e "$t" ]; then OUT+=("$t|NOT-SAFE|unreachable|path missing or empty"); continue; fi

  if [ -d "$t" ] && [ -d "$t/.git" ]; then
    unp=$(git -C "$t" log --oneline HEAD --not --remotes 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
    dirt=$(git -C "$t" status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | wc -l)
    if ledger_match "$t"; then OUT+=("$t|SAFE|moved-to-obsidian|ledger"); else OUT+=("$t|NOT-SAFE|none|unpushed=$unp dirty=$dirt"); fi
    continue
  fi

  repo=$(git -C "$(dirname "$t")" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ -n "$repo" ]; then
    def=$(resolve_default_ref "$repo" || true)
    intro=$(git -C "$repo" log --diff-filter=A --format=%H -1 -- "$t" 2>/dev/null || true)
    if [ -n "$def" ] && [ -n "$intro" ] && git -C "$repo" merge-base --is-ancestor "$intro" "refs/remotes/origin/$def" 2>/dev/null; then
      OUT+=("$t|SAFE|pushed|intro=${intro:0:12} ancestor-of=origin/$def"); continue
    fi
    if ledger_match "$t"; then OUT+=("$t|SAFE|moved-to-obsidian|ledger row sha match"); continue; fi
    base=$(basename "$t")
    scratchy=0
    case "$t" in */.scratch/*|*.out|*.log|*checkpoint*.json|*checkpoint*.png|*-draft.*) scratchy=1 ;; esac
    if [ "$scratchy" = "1" ] && [ "$(live_refs "$base" "$ROOT")" = "0" ] \
       && [ -n "$(find "$t" -maxdepth 0 -mtime +"$STALE_DAYS" 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
      OUT+=("$t|SAFE|stale|mtime>$STALE_DAYS refs=0"); continue
    fi
    if [ -z "$def" ]; then OUT+=("$t|NOT-SAFE|pushed-unverifiable|no default branch ref"); continue; fi
  fi
  OUT+=("$t|NOT-SAFE|none|no receipt")
done

if [ "$JSON" = "1" ]; then
  printf '['
  first=1
  for l in "${OUT[@]}"; do
    IFS='|' read -r p v r e <<<"$l"
    [ $first = 1 ] || printf ','
    first=0
    jq -cn --arg p "$p" --arg v "$v" --arg r "$r" --arg e "$e" '{path:$p,verdict:$v,receipt:$r,evidence:$e}'
  done
  printf ']\n'
else
  for l in "${OUT[@]}"; do
    IFS='|' read -r p v r e <<<"$l"
    printf 'VERDICT\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$p" "$v" "$r" "$e"
  done
fi
exit 0
review_harness.battery_sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Reviewer S38 adversarial battery v2. Usage: battery.sh <tool> <sandbox> <out.tsv>
set -uo pipefail
TOOL="$1"; SB="$2"; OUT="$3"
: > "$OUT"
PASS=0; FAIL=0; SKIP=0

OUTDIR=$(mktemp -d "$SB/.battery.XXXXXX")
EXFIL="$OUTDIR/exit"

run() { # run <ex-file> <args...>; echoes exit code
  local exf="$1"; shift
  ( "$TOOL" "$@" ; echo "exit=$?" > "$exf" ) > "$OUTDIR/rec.out" 2>&1 || true
  sed -n 's/^exit=//p' "$exf"
}

case_row() {
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$1" "$2" "$3" "$4" "$5" >> "$OUT"
  case "$4" in PASS) PASS=$((PASS+1));; FAIL) FAIL=$((FAIL+1));; *) SKIP=$((SKIP+1));; esac
}

norm() { sed -e "s@$SB@SB@g" -e 's/\t/|/g'; }

# expect <case> <SAFE|NOT-SAFE> <regex on receipt OR evidence> <expected rc> <args...>
expect() {
  local case="$1" ev="$2" er="$3" erc="$4"; shift 4
  local rc; rc=$(run "$EXFIL" "$@")
  local line; line=$(grep -v '^exit=' "$OUTDIR/rec.out" | grep -v '^$' | head -1)
  local map; map=$(norm <<<"$line")
  local gv gr ge
  gv=$(cut -d$'\t' -f3 <<<"$line"); gr=$(cut -d$'\t' -f4 <<<"$line"); ge=$(cut -d$'\t' -f5 <<<"$line")
  if [ "$rc" != "$erc" ]; then case_row "$case" "rc=$erc" "rc=$rc" FAIL "map=$map"; return; fi
  if [ "$gv" != "$ev" ]; then case_row "$case" "$ev" "${gv:-<none>}" FAIL "map=$map"; return; fi
  if grep -Eq "$er" <<<"$gr" || grep -Eq "$er" <<<"$ge"; then
    case_row "$case" "$ev/$er rc=$erc" "ok" PASS "map=$map"
  else
    case_row "$case" "$ev/$er" "$gv/${gr:-<none>}" FAIL "map=$map"
  fi
}

# sandbox override detection
export SOUJI_LEDGER="$SB/souji-shokunin/corpus/knowledge/obsidian-ledger.tsv"
export SOUJI_VAULT="$SB/vault"
SRC="${4:-$TOOL}"
OVERRIDE=""
if grep -q 'SHOKUNIN_ROOT' "$SRC" 2>/dev/null; then OVERRIDE=SHOKUNIN_ROOT; fi
if [ -z "$OVERRIDE" ]; then
  for v in SOUJI_ROOT SOUJI_VERIFY_ROOT; do
    if grep -q "$v" "$SRC" 2>/dev/null; then OVERRIDE="$v"; break; fi
  done
fi
if [ -n "$OVERRIDE" ]; then
  export "$OVERRIDE=$SB"
  SANDBOXED=1
else
  SANDBOXED=0
fi

if [ "$SANDBOXED" = 1 ]; then
  expect F1-pushed                      SAFE     '^pushed$'              0 "$SB/beta-shokunin/notes/keep.txt"
  expect F2-local-only                  NOT-SAFE 'none|pushed-unverifiable' 0 "$SB/alpha-shokunin/data/local-only.txt"
  expect F9-originHEAD-absent           SAFE     '^pushed$'              0 "$SB/gamma-shokunin/g.txt"
  expect F6-ledger-match                SAFE     '^moved-to-obsidian$'   0 "$SB/epsilon-shokunin/export.md"
  expect F6-neg-source-sha              NOT-SAFE 'none|pushed-unverifiable' 0 "$SB/zeta-shokunin/mismatch.md"
  expect F6-neg-vault-sha               NOT-SAFE 'none|pushed-unverifiable' 0 "$SB/eta-shokunin/vaultmm.md"
  expect F4-wt-absent-unique0           SAFE     '^metadata-prune$'      0 "$SB/wt-absent"
  expect F5-wt-unpushed-branch          NOT-SAFE 'unpushed-branch'       0 "$SB/wt-branch"
  expect F5b-wt-present-dirty           NOT-SAFE 'dirty'                 0 "$SB/wt-dirty"
  expect F7-stale-norefs                SAFE     '^stale$'               0 "$SB/alpha-shokunin/.scratch/old-thing.log"
  expect F8-stale-census-pollution      SAFE     '^stale$'               0 "$SB/alpha-shokunin/.scratch/keepme.log"
  expect F8b-stale-real-content-ref     NOT-SAFE 'none'                  0 "$SB/alpha-shokunin/.scratch/ctl.log"
  expect F13-fresh-not-stale            NOT-SAFE 'none'                  0 "$SB/alpha-shokunin/.scratch/fresh.log"
  expect F13-threshold-30               NOT-SAFE 'none'                  0 --stale-days 30 "$SB/alpha-shokunin/.scratch/old-thing.log"
else
  for c in F1-pushed F2-local-only F9-originHEAD-absent F6-ledger-match F6-neg-source-sha F6-neg-vault-sha F4-wt-absent-unique0 F5-wt-unpushed-branch F7-stale-norefs F8-stale-census-pollution F8b-stale-real-content-ref F13-fresh-not-stale F13-threshold-30; do
    case_row "$c" "sandboxed" "no-env-override-in-tool" SKIP "tool exposes no SHOKUNIN_ROOT/SOUJI_ROOT override; fixture cannot be hosted in a sandbox"
  done
fi

# always runnable: repo-root kind, secrets, unreachable, contract
expect F3-repo-root-dirty             NOT-SAFE 'unpushed=[1-9]'          0 "$SB/alpha-shokunin"
expect F1b-clean-repo-root            NOT-SAFE 'unpushed=0'             0 "$SB/beta-shokunin"
expect F10-dotenv                     NOT-SAFE 'secrets-refusal'        0 "$SB/secret-dir/.env"
expect F10b-credentials               NOT-SAFE 'secrets-refusal'        0 "$SB/secret-dir/credentials.json"
expect F11-missing-target             NOT-SAFE 'unreachable'            0 "$SB/no-such-path"

rc=$(run "$EXFIL" --bogus)
[ "${rc:-}" = 2 ] && case_row usage-unknown-flag "rc=2" "rc=$rc" PASS "" || case_row usage-unknown-flag "rc=2" "rc=${rc:-none}" FAIL ""
rc=$(run "$EXFIL")
[ "${rc:-}" = 2 ] && case_row usage-no-targets "rc=2" "rc=$rc" PASS "" || case_row usage-no-targets "rc=2" "rc=${rc:-none}" FAIL ""

rc=$(run "$EXFIL" "$SB/beta-shokunin/notes/keep.txt" "$SB/no-such-path")
n=$(grep -c $'^VERDICT\t' "$OUTDIR/rec.out" 2>/dev/null || true)

ln=$(grep -m1 $'^VERDICT\t' "$OUTDIR/rec.out" || true)

[ "$nf" = 5 ] && case_row line-5-tab-fields "5" "$nf" PASS "$(norm <<<"$ln")" || case_row line-5-tab-fields "5" "${nf:-0}" FAIL "$(norm <<<"$ln")"

"$TOOL" "$SB/beta-shokunin/notes/keep.txt" "$SB/no-such-path" > "$OUTDIR/d2" 2>&1 || true

if jq -e . "$OUTDIR/j.out" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  case_row json-parses "valid JSON" ok PASS "shape=$(jq -c 'if type=="array" then (.[0]|keys_unsorted) else keys_unsorted end' "$OUTDIR/j.out" 2>/dev/null | head -c 140)"
else
  case_row json-parses "valid JSON" invalid FAIL "head=$(head -c 160 "$OUTDIR/j.out" | norm)"

rc=$(run "$EXFIL" "$SB/secret-dir/.env" "$SB/no-such-path")
[ "${rc:-}" = 0 ] && case_row exit0-for-all-notsafe "rc=0" "rc=$rc" PASS "" || case_row exit0-for-all-notsafe "rc=0" "rc=${rc:-none}" FAIL ""

hash_before=$(cd "$SB" && find . -path ./.battery.* -prune -o -type f -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum | sha256sum)
"$TOOL" "$SB/alpha-shokunin" "$SB/beta-shokunin/notes/keep.txt" "$SB/wt-absent" "$SB/alpha-shokunin/.scratch/old-thing.log" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
hash_after=$(cd "$SB" && find . -path ./.battery.* -prune -o -type f -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum | sha256sum)
[ "$hash_before" = "$hash_after" ] && case_row read-only-sandbox-hash unchanged unchanged PASS "" \
  || case_row read-only-sandbox-hash unchanged CHANGED FAIL "before=$hash_before after=$hash_after"

rm -rf "$OUTDIR"
review_harness.fixtures_sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Reviewer S38: build an independent fixture sandbox mirroring $SHOKUNIN_ROOT shape.
set -euo pipefail
SB="$1"
rm -rf "$SB"; mkdir -p "$SB"

gi() { git -C "$1" init -q -b master; }

export GIT_AUTHOR_NAME="souji-review" GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL="review@shokunin.local"
export GIT_COMMITTER_NAME="souji-review" GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL="review@shokunin.local"

# --- alpha-shokunin: dirty + unpushed (F3, F2, F7, F8, F8b, F13b, control) ----
A="$SB/alpha-shokunin"; mkdir -p "$A/data" "$A/.scratch"; gi "$A"
printf 'alpha report v1\n' > "$A/data/report.txt"
git -C "$A" add -A; git -C "$A" commit -qm c1
git -C "$A" update-ref refs/remotes/origin/master HEAD
git -C "$A" symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD refs/remotes/origin/master
printf 'local only\n' > "$A/data/local-only.txt"
printf 'notes: control ref to ctl.log lives here\n' > "$A/notes.md"
git -C "$A" add -A; git -C "$A" commit -qm c2
printf 'uncommitted edit\n' >> "$A/notes.md"          # dirty (tracked modification)
printf 'old scratch\n'   > "$A/.scratch/old-thing.log"
printf 'keep me\n'       > "$A/.scratch/keepme.log"
printf 'referenced elsewhere\n' > "$A/.scratch/ctl.log"
printf 'fresh scratch\n' > "$A/.scratch/fresh.log"
touch -d '3 days ago' "$A/.scratch/old-thing.log" "$A/.scratch/keepme.log" "$A/.scratch/ctl.log"

# census-like dirs that must be excluded from the reference sweep (D3) — both
# inside the fixture repo and at sandbox root, to cover either sweep root.
mkdir -p "$SB/souji-shokunin/census/round-1"
printf '{"seat":"S99","ref":"keepme.log"}\n' > "$SB/souji-shokunin/census/round-1/seat-99.json"

# --- beta-shokunin: clean, pushed (F1) --------------------------------------
B="$SB/beta-shokunin"; mkdir -p "$B/notes"; gi "$B"
printf 'keep\n' > "$B/notes/keep.txt"
git -C "$B" add -A; git -C "$B" commit -qm c1
git -C "$B" update-ref refs/remotes/origin/master HEAD
git -C "$B" symbolic-ref refs/remotes/origin/HEAD refs/remotes/origin/master

# --- gamma-shokunin: no origin/HEAD, single origin/trunk (F9) ---------------
G="$SB/gamma-shokunin"; mkdir -p "$G"; gi "$G"
printf 'g\n' > "$G/g.txt"
git -C "$G" add -A; git -C "$G" commit -qm c1
git -C "$G" update-ref refs/remotes/origin/trunk HEAD

# --- delta-shokunin: worktree owner (F4, F5) --------------------------------
D="$SB/delta-shokunin"; mkdir -p "$D"; gi "$D"
printf 'd\n' > "$D/d.txt"
git -C "$D" add -A; git -C "$D" commit -qm c1
git -C "$D" worktree add -q --detach "$SB/wt-absent"
rm -rf "$SB/wt-absent"
git -C "$D" worktree add -q -b feat "$SB/wt-branch"
printf 'feat\n' > "$SB/wt-branch/feat.txt"
git -C "$SB/wt-branch" add -A; git -C "$SB/wt-branch" commit -qm c-feat
git -C "$D" worktree add -q --detach "$SB/wt-dirty"
printf 'untracked work\n' > "$SB/wt-dirty/stray.txt"

# --- epsilon-shokunin: ledger source on a side branch (F6) ------------------
E="$SB/epsilon-shokunin"; mkdir -p "$E"; gi "$E"
printf 'base\n' > "$E/base.txt"
git -C "$E" add -A; git -C "$E" commit -qm base
git -C "$E" checkout -qb side
printf 'the exported artifact\n' > "$E/export.md"
git -C "$E" add -A; git -C "$E" commit -qm c-export
git -C "$E" checkout -q master
printf 'the exported artifact\n' > "$E/export.md"   # untracked copy on master, identical bytes

# --- zeta-shokunin: ledger row with sha mismatch (negative F6) --------------
Z="$SB/zeta-shokunin"; mkdir -p "$Z"; gi "$Z"
printf 'base\n' > "$Z/base.txt"
git -C "$Z" add -A; git -C "$Z" commit -qm base
git -C "$Z" checkout -qb side
printf 'mismatch test\n' > "$Z/mismatch.md"
git -C "$Z" add -A; git -C "$Z" commit -qm c-mm
git -C "$Z" checkout -q master
printf 'mismatch test\n' > "$Z/mismatch.md"          # untracked copy on master, identical bytes

# --- eta-shokunin: ledger row, correct source sha, vault sha mismatch (neg F6)
ET="$SB/eta-shokunin"; mkdir -p "$ET"; gi "$ET"
printf 'base\n' > "$ET/base.txt"
git -C "$ET" add -A; git -C "$ET" commit -qm base
git -C "$ET" checkout -qb side
printf 'vault mismatch\n' > "$ET/vaultmm.md"
git -C "$ET" add -A; git -C "$ET" commit -qm c-vm
git -C "$ET" checkout -q master
printf 'vault mismatch\n' > "$ET/vaultmm.md"
mkdir -p "$SB/vault"
printf 'DIFFERENT VAULT BYTES\n' > "$SB/vault/vaultmm.md"

# --- vault side (read-only target for ledger rows) --------------------------
mkdir -p "$SB/vault"
cp "$E/export.md" "$SB/vault/export.md"
cp "$Z/mismatch.md" "$SB/vault/mismatch.md"

# --- ledger mirror ----------------------------------------------------------
mkdir -p "$SB/souji-shokunin/corpus/knowledge"
L="$SB/souji-shokunin/corpus/knowledge/obsidian-ledger.tsv"
{
  printf 'source_path\tsource_sha256\tvault_path\tvault_sha256\texported_at\tnote\n'
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t2026-10-18\tfixture\n' \
    "$E/export.md" "$(sha256sum "$E/export.md" | cut -d' ' -f1)" \
    "$SB/vault/export.md" "$(sha256sum "$SB/vault/export.md" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t2026-10-18\tfixture-sha-mismatch\n' \
    "$Z/mismatch.md" "$(printf 'deadbeef%.0s' {1..8})" \
    "$SB/vault/mismatch.md" "$(sha256sum "$SB/vault/mismatch.md" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t2026-10-18\tvault-sha-unverifiable\n' \
    "$ET/vaultmm.md" "$(sha256sum "$ET/vaultmm.md" | cut -d' ' -f1)" \
    "$SB/vault/vaultmm.md" "$(printf 'ab%.0s' {1..32})"
} > "$L"

# --- secrets fixture (F10) --------------------------------------------------
mkdir -p "$SB/secret-dir"
printf 'TOKEN=fixture-not-real\n' > "$SB/secret-dir/.env"
printf 'plain\n' > "$SB/secret-dir/credentials.json"

echo "fixtures built at $SB"
